title: Experiment instance quality
description: Grades completed whole-instance experiments by the selected arm's composite score so instance-level experiments become trendable scorecards.

criteria.title: Whole-instance composite
criteria.model: The selected instance variant improves or preserves the whole-instance judged composite without hiding failures in unscored cells.
criteria.method: Read selected-arm mean composite, scored/cell counts, and baseline comparison from the experiment scorecard evidence.
criteria.driftMarkers: Composite is degraded, no cells scored, or winners are selected with weak evidence.
